summary: Tested P1/P2 additions: admin auth guards + dashboard, quote email delivery, Instagram Reels curated fallback, Ken Burns hero, i18n RTL toggle, Cost Calculator PDF + email flow, and PWA manifest/sw. Backend pytest 29/29 passed. All frontend flows verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: variable name shadowing in /api/instagram/reels — inner `httpx.AsyncClient(...) as client` shadows the module-level `client = AsyncIOMotorClient(...)`. Not a bug today but rename to `http` to avoid future foot-guns.
server.py: /api/quote/{quote_id}/email accepts a body-level quote_id that could mismatch the path param — path param is authoritative; consider dropping body quote_id or validating equality.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (added 11 tests: admin auth guard, admin CRUD list, admin stats, register is_admin flag, quote email delivery, instagram curated)
seed_data_creation: Admin user auto-seeded on backend startup. Multiple TEST_ prefixed contacts/quotes generated by pytest runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All P1/P2 features work. Backend: admin routes gated by get_admin_user (401 no token, 403 non-admin, 200 admin). Quote email POST /api/quote/{id}/email returns {status:queued} or 404. Instagram curated fallback returns 6 items when INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN unset. Frontend: /admin protected via localStorage.ka_user.is_admin (login BEFORE nav). Cost Calc PDF triggers browser download (jsPDF), verified filename Kashmir-Atelier-Estimate-{id}.pdf. Language toggle flips document.documentElement.dir between ltr/rtl. Manifest & sw served at 200.
